title: Images on a resume...❌ NO ❌
description:
Is adding graphics to your resume hurting your chances of getting hired? It’s highly likely. Graphics serve no impact for your tangible skills and career experience and at the extreme end can even state you are under qualified for the position. Graphics lead a level of interpretation of the visuals when you want to be direct with all your content. A simple resume is a good resume. #resume #resumebuilder #resumetips #jobsearch #jobsearchtips
